about: What a skincare brand may change in the Sereine design. Protected: the scroll-run batch (the bottle filled active by active, sealed, a dropper carried to a cross-section of skin, the drop absorbed, the barrier smoother four weeks on), the routine builder, the ingredient list with its strength bars, the shop with sizes, subscription and the delivery meter, the bottle drawings, layout, type and all interaction code. The brand's own words, actives and their percentages, products, skin types and concerns, ingredients and prices come from the content.
rules: Text may not contain < > { } or line breaks.

stages: the six steps of the hero, in order: the bottle, the actives going in, sealed, one drop, absorbed, the result weeks on. Each a short name and a caption; claims about results stay modest and honest.

actives: two to four actives of the hero product, in the order they are poured, each with its percentage and the colour of its layer. batch: the batch label, millilitres, pH, the days to the result and the glass colour.

routine: skin types and concerns the routine builder offers; each concern has a line on why the routine helps. shop.products: two to four products, each drawn as a dropper, pump, jar or tube in its colour, with sizes [ml, price], when it's used (am, pm, both), its step in a routine, the skin types it suits ('all' or names from routine.skins), the concerns it answers (from routine.concerns), and basic: true when it goes in every routine it suits.
ingredients.list: what's inside, with its percentage, what it does, where it comes from, what it works with, what to keep it apart from, and the products it's in (by id).
